headline: Quiet day: Musk says SpaceX closed $40B in GPU debt
body: A quiet Sunday. Elon Musk said SpaceX closed about $40 billion of debt for GPUs arriving in early 2027 and warned that most neoclouds face a shakeout as credit dries up. It nudged Capability Velocity (+0.03) and Power Concentration (+0.03). Scores barely moved as earlier news faded. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance slipped to -14.91 from -14.88.
movers_note: No ending moved more than 0.03. Benevolent Dictator and Protector God each slipped 0.03, mostly as earlier news faded (-0.04 and -0.05), slightly offset by the SpaceX financing (+0.01 each).
coming_up: SpaceX GPU deliveries expected in Q1-Q2 2027
